speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: In, and keep to our pew. The floor is rushes, the church is full, and the Mayor is already seated.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Halberds at his door. They were not at that door on Whitsunday.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then you have seen them. Sit, and do not walk the aisle to count them.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I come with the house, mistress. Not to come would be noticed.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You come, and you sit where you sat on Whitsunday. That is all the notice this church requires of you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sit with the house. That is the whole of it.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: We shall be brief, brethren. The powers that be are ordained of God.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Masters are to keep their servants in. A house that lets them run has already given its answer.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Whoso resisteth, resisteth the ordinance. I have no second text for you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One turning. He has set it down.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Mark me. He set it down on Whitsunday by order, and he has set it down today.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: I set the glass down. One turning. You have had the ordinance. Keep your servants, and go to your dinners.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I am in the pew, sir. I am kept.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Hush. He was not speaking to you alone, and the pew is not a place to answer him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He was speaking to every master here. I have heard him.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Go out quietly. The Mayor's door is not a place to gather, and the porch is not a market.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Out by our own door. We do not collect a company between this pew and the close.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Home, then. I have nothing to set beside an ordinance.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The halberds stay at his door. They do not follow a household into the close.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. Let the Mayor keep his own door. I will keep mine, and I will know who is behind it.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The glass stays down. If you want a longer feast, the ordinance has already said the rest.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: We have it. Out, and no lingering where the halberds can count you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Under our own lintel, then. I am not giving them a second look at this pew.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will keep the mistress's pace. I am not in a hurry to be seen twice in one morning.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Twice is already too many, if the second time is a knot of men. Walk.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am walking. Sunday is church and the house, and I have done the church.
